headline: Palantir posts a first $2B+ quarter with revenue up 96%; Anthropic IPO, Marvell-Lumentum and Qwen-for-Apple stay in play

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: It's three oh three UTC on Tuesday, November third. This is ARA AI News, and tonight Palantir has reported a blowout quarter while the Anthropic listing and a big chip merger remain the main stories.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Palantir's third-quarter revenue rose ninety-six percent from a year ago to two point three billion dollars, and it's the first time the company has topped two billion in a single quarter.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: Profits are striking too. GAAP net income was one point one billion dollars, a forty-nine percent margin, and adjusted free cash flow was one point two billion.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: The mix matters. U.S. commercial revenue grew one hundred forty-eight percent, and Palantir says it has now passed U.S. government revenue for the first time in the company's history.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: Looking ahead, Palantir guides next-quarter revenue to roughly two point six five billion dollars. There was no call transcript at the time we checked, so we're relying on the press release.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: In that release, chief executive Alex Karp framed it as a sovereign AI divide, saying institutions are being pushed into either the haves or the have nots.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: Now the rest of the board. On Anthropic, the amended S-1 filed Monday shows third-quarter revenue of sixteen point nine six billion dollars.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: But also a five hundred sixty-seven million dollar operating loss, after a profit in the second quarter, driven by expensive short-term compute. The filing also warns future models may soon reach its AI-accelerated-progress threshold.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: On chips, Marvell's planned combination with Lumentum reportedly values Lumentum near one hundred fifteen billion dollars in all stock, closing in 2028. Those terms come from one trader's posts, not a filing we hold, so treat them with care.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Both stocks reportedly fell sharply on the news, Marvell about thirteen percent and Lumentum nearly nineteen.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: And on Google, SemiAnalysis's new GDPx benchmark has Gemini 4 Carbon second behind Claude Opus five point five, at about a third of the cost per task.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: Separately, unconfirmed reports say Alibaba's Qwen four is due this week, and that Apple Intelligence in China will use Qwen, with developer testing starting tomorrow. Neither company has confirmed.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: We've also closed out our finance and legal agents thread, which has gone quiet.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.text: What to watch: how Palantir trades when markets open, the Anthropic roadshow and price range, and whether Apple or Alibaba confirm the Qwen deal.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.text: That's ARA AI News. We'll be back when the picture changes.
